upload_performance.name: Upload performance
upload_performance.description: Advanced. Peak memory used during an upload is roughly (parts uploaded at once + 1) x part size. The defaults (20 MiB, 1 at a time) suit any hardware, including 1-2 GB Raspberry Pis. With 4 GB+ RAM and a good upload connection try 32 MiB x 3; with 8 GB+ and fast upload try 64 MiB x 4 (64 MiB also matches Storj's segment size).

data_description.part_size_mib: Size of each multipart upload part (5-256 MiB). Larger parts mean fewer requests but more memory. Default: 20.
data_description.max_concurrency: How many parts are uploaded in parallel (1-8). More parts in parallel uses more of your upload bandwidth and more memory. Default: 1.
